heading_path: 19.2  Persons to whom Registrar may delegate (Act, s 206(1))
text: For subsection 206(1) of the Act, a person holding, or performing the duties of, an office in the Trade Marks Office stated in Schedule 6 is a person to whom the Registrar may delegate all or any of the Registrar’s powers or functions under the Act.
